question_prompt: Q9: In your industry and role, what do you think of the relationship between productivity and the number of hours worked?
panels: Q9: In your industry and role, what do you think of the relationship between productivity and the number of hours worked?
answers: The more time I spend working, the more productive I am to a point. Any time I spend working after my limit leads to decreased productivity
The more time I spend working, the more productive I am
Productivity and time spent working are not related – how productive I am is related to other factors
The more time I spend working, the less productive I am
